title: CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss
summary: Bitcoin Magazine CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss CleanSpark's CFO said the miner may sell more bitcoin than it mines to reduce risk after a $987.1 million fiscal 2026 loss, as its shares hit a new 52-week low. This post CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
